premises.text: Travelers struggle to see total personal value of fragmented air, hotel, car, and card rewards and which offers fit them
premises.evidence_span: this number is pretty hard to come by

premises.text: A dashboard aggregates reward accounts, balances, personal value, growth, and risk of losing points or status
premises.evidence_span: a super smart dashboard that organizes all your points in one spot

premises.text: Deep analysis of spending versus peers projects points forward and recommends cards or actions that raise rewards and status sooner
premises.evidence_span: the technology that we developed to track your value over time and project it forward

premises.text: Trip planning filters destinations and overlays Kayak results with which offer is best suited—not merely cheapest—including points versus cash
premises.evidence_span: we will go bring results from Kayak and overlay them with which offer is best suited for you, not necessarily the cheapest one

premises.text: Service is free to consumers; Superfly earns referral fees from airlines, reward cards, and others when users take recommendations
premises.evidence_span: When the user saves, we make money off the referral fee that we get not from the user

value.text: Help travelers become savvy by organizing points and choosing the best-suited rewards offers

organizes all your points in one spot, scans all the rewards that are out there
give them intelligent suggestions about how to earn more points, get the status faster, or spend the points more wisely
